label: Income from public office (MP, then Prime Minister) declared for 2023
detail: As reported by Pravda, TA3 and STVR (TASR) from the declarations for 2023 published by the parliamentary committee on 7 November 2024. Slovak public officials file an annual declaration (oznámenie funkcionára) with the National Council's Committee on Incompatibility of Functions, which publishes it on nrsr.sk; that site was not readable for this research (bot check), so the figures are taken from press reports that cite the declaration.
